summary: This PR adds the project's initial configuration template (.env.example with Codeberg token, Ollama, and poll interval settings), a .gitignore file, and a comprehensive README overhaul with architecture documentation, quick start guide, token scope table, usage examples, and troubleshooting section. All changes are documentation and configuration only.

items.description: Well-structured README with clear sections. Consider adding a CI/CD badge or contributing guide link.
